The graph has three cycles and no exponential path growth; nested inverse cylinders prove countability. The independent Fraction-only preimage checker passed 42 rational pairs through n=10 and non-reflection equal-width cases. All endpoints are Lebesgue-null, and every strict parameter inequality is used.

The 2026 primary paper studies symbolic survivor spaces and dimension staircases, not the measured finite-time law. Bunimovich-Yurchenko treats location effects and commuting symmetries; these non-reflection-related holes are not connected by any small translation commuting with negative doubling.
